title: Really nice treat night activity.
text: Really nice evening with the last stop being well worth the cost of admission.
author: OlafandSven

title: Gourmet food and wine tour=Excellent!!
text: Brian was a wonderful tour guide. He shared many cultural tapas and drinks. I loved learning about Barcelonas gourmet foods.
author: nicolecm876

title: Brais’ food tour rocks
text: Brais, our food tour guy,  was amazing.  he was so knowledgeable and enthusiastic.  his english is superb. we visited 4 restaurants, each served us unique and tasty tapas. the drinks selection was plentiful.  this is a “ must do” for your Barcelona trip. well worth the price.
author: donnalS2482DL

title: Great food and wine tour!
text: Our guide was great.. and the food especially at the final stop was delicious!
author: jkhmross

title: Wonderful tapas and wine
text: Fantastic experience! The food and wine pairings were excellent and our guide Brain was extremely knowledgeable and very personable. We stopped at 3 restaurants and loved each one. Do yourself a favor and book this tour!
author: anthonysM6827GK

title: Highly recommended
text: Great tour, friendly host, shared so many insights about Barcelona and the food scene. Our guide Brian kept all guests engaged. The restaurants, pace, and menu selections were on point. Highly recommend!
author: monicarD2838HA

title: We had a fantastic...
text: We had a fantastic Barcelona tapas and wine tour with Brian! He was friendly, knowledgeable, and made the entire evening fun and enjoyable. The food and wine selections were excellent, and Brian gave us great insight into Barcelona and its food culture. It was one of the highlights of our time in Barcelona. Highly recommend Brian and this tour!
author: Kevin_L

title: Do not miss this tour!
text: This was an amazing tour. Brian was extremely knowledgeable about the food and wine and chose fabulous places to take us. Every bite of food and every sip of wine was off the charts good. It was a very high end tour and we had a blast. Best tour in our 12 day vacation through 3 countries by far!!
author: Patricia_L

title: Tapas and wine tour
text: We had a the MOST FABULOUS NIGHT !! Enjoyed Brian and all his recommendations ! Made the BEST recommendations for food and tourist experiences  -  our group was from USA, Australia AND New Zealand ! It was great!! Highly recommend!
author: melissabR798HS

title: Great food & drink, and fantastic dinner companions
text: Our family of 5 loved this tour with our guide Brain. The food was phenomenal, the drinks were fantastic and the dinner company with conversation was fantastic. I highly recommend this tour to anyone of drinking age.
author: EtoiD
